description.value: J-Zone is a Japanese specialty store operated by J-Zone Trading Inc., stocking imported Japanese food products including instant noodles, frozen meat and fish, seasonings, snacks, and drinks alongside non-food items like stationery, toys, and trading cards. The store describes itself as 'a small trip to Japan' with staff knowledgeable about Japanese products. Touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's Renfrew neighbourhood can resupply here with packaged foods, snacks, and cold drinks.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 18m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms J-Zone is an active Japanese specialty store (J-Zone Trading Inc.) selling food, snacks, drinks, and frozen goods alongside non-food items like toys and accessories — substantial food inventory supports the Groceries category. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site. OSM lists no phone number and the website omits a street address, so only the website URL can be cross-confirmed.
concerns: OSM name is 'J-Zone' (hyphenated) while the website consistently uses 'J Zone' (no hyphen) as the display name — minor discrepancy retained per OSM-priority rule.

Store sells significant non-food merchandise (toys, accessories, stationery); Groceries category is defensible given the food component but the store is better characterized as a Japanese variety/specialty shop.
No street address listed on the website; OSM address at 1663 Renfrew Street cannot be corroborated from website content alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Japanese specialty grocery and variety store with a functioning website, Shopify storefront, and substantial food inventory useful to touring cyclists resupplying in the Renfrew area.
